Databases & Middleware.reason: A critical vulnerability in Oracle WebCenter Enterprise Capture allows unauthenticated remote attackers to compromise the system via HTTP, posing a severe risk to enterprise middleware deployments.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: A critical vulnerability in Oracle WebCenter Enterprise Capture allows unauthenticated remote attackers to compromise the system via HTTP, posing a severe risk to enterprise middleware deployments.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Oracle WebCenter Enterprise Capture 中存在严重漏洞，允许未授权的远程攻击者通过 HTTP 破坏系统，对企业中间件部署构成严重风险。

Databases & Middleware.reason: ArcadeDB's Gremlin query engine silently falls back to an insecure Groovy engine, allowing authenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: ArcadeDB's Gremlin query engine silently falls back to an insecure Groovy engine, allowing authenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: ArcadeDB 的 Gremlin 查询引擎会静默回退到不安全的 Groovy 引擎，允许已授权攻击者实现远程代码执行。

Databases & Middleware.reason_en: An integer overflow in DragonflyDB's CMS.INITBYDIM command leads to an undersized buffer allocation, potentially causing memory corruption and denial of service.

Databases & Middleware.reason: Easily exploitable unauthenticated vulnerability in Oracle Helidon allows complete compromise of the middleware via HTTP.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Easily exploitable unauthenticated vulnerability in Oracle Helidon allows complete compromise of the middleware via HTTP.

Other.reason: An integer overflow leading to a double-free condition in libarchive's RAR processing can cause memory corruption when handling malicious archives.
Other.reason_en: An integer overflow leading to a double-free condition in libarchive's RAR processing can cause memory corruption when handling malicious archives.
Other.reason_zh: libarchive 的 RAR 处理逻辑中存在整数溢出漏洞，可导致双重释放问题，在处理恶意压缩包时会引发内存损坏。

summary_en: This batch highlights critical cloud authentication bypasses in Azure services, severe RCE flaws in Windows and SharePoint, and significant vulnerabilities in IoT and middleware platforms. | This batch is dominated by high-severity Microsoft Windows and server vulnerabilities, featuring critical RCEs in RDP, SMB, and DHCP, alongside highly probable EoP exploits and severe SharePoint/Exchange flaws. | This batch is dominated by critical Microsoft vulnerabilities, including an actively exploited WinSock LPE, multiple CVSS 9.8 RCEs in Windows DNS and QUIC, and severe flaws in Exchange and SharePoint.
summary_zh: 本批次重点披露了 Azure 服务中严重的云身份验证绕过漏洞、Windows 和 SharePoint 中的严重 RCE 漏洞，以及 IoT 和中间件平台中的重大漏洞。| 本批次以高危 Microsoft Windows 及服务器漏洞为主，涵盖 RDP、SMB 和 DHCP 中的严重 RCE 漏洞，以及极可能被利用的 EoP 漏洞和严重的 SharePoint/Exchange 漏洞。| 本批次主要涉及严重的 Microsoft 漏洞，包括一个正被在野利用的 WinSock LPE 漏洞、Windows DNS 和 QUIC 中多个 CVSS 评分为 9.8 的 RCE 漏洞，以及 Exchange 和 SharePoint 中的严重漏洞。
